name: h3x-v2-web
description: H3X v2 browser workspace and Cloudflare Worker

scripts.build: npm run prepare:shared && npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/build-worker.mjs
scripts.test: npm run prepare:shared && node scripts/build-worker.mjs && node --test electron/*.test.cjs tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.deploy:check: npm run build && npx wrangler@4 deploy --dry-run
